verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud gives every project an auto-configured MCP server, so users can work with their project data in natural language from ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI interfaces. It also offers AI-powered NLP search and AnswerSession, a ChatGPT-like Q&A feature. However, the evidence covers natural-language querying of data, not natural-language operation of the product itself (creating indexes, inserting data, configuring data sources), and the MCP capability is limited to Cloud. Missing for 10: natural-language control of administrative and configuration operations, detail on which MCP tools exist beyond data interaction, natural-language operation in the open-source library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
